title: neogaya simplex
intro: Neogaya simplex, commonly known as the "Indian Snakeroot," is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Himalayan region and other parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it effective in reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating various infections. The therapeutic actions of Neogaya simplex include its ability to stimulate digestion, alleviate respiratory issues, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
